caption: The drawing depicts an old, partially damaged chest with its lid open. The exterior of the chest is dark brown with visible scuffs, scratches, and patches where the material has worn away to reveal a lighter color underneath; there are also metallic fittings at the corners and a brass plate on the front. The open lid reveals an interior that is decorated with a rectangular red panel bordered by blue ornamental scrollwork and a central yellowish band with a clasp. The background is plain and off-white, and the chest is rendered with noticeable attention to the texture and color variations of both the exterior and interior surfaces. There is a small inscription or signature at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Stage Coach Trunk
